children: JGB futures fall in the early Tokyo session, tracking Friday's price declines in U.S. Treasurys market. Both JGBs and Treasurys tend to move in tandem. JGB prices may also be weighed by prospects of further BOJ rate increases. The BOJ will likely "tighten further despite sluggish GDP growth," Capital Economics' Marcel Thieliant says, noting preliminary government data released earlier showing Japan's economy contracted in 3Q. "It looks increasingly likely that the Bank will have to tighten policy more aggressively than we've been anticipating as inflation is about to surge," the head of Asia-Pacific adds. Benchmark 10-year JGB futures are 0.16 yen lower at 126.17 yen. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
